subject: Pilot cohort: escrowed credits + bulk-seat pricing for Soar Accelerator
messages:
From: Marta Silva <marta@soaraccelerator.org>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot cohort: proposal for bulk seats + escrowed credits

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was excited about the latency/throughput details and the idea of private VPC options for sensitive projects. We run three cohorts/year and want to include Redwood as our default inference provider for startups that need production-like performance during program months.

High-level proposal:
- Commit: 40 bulk seats (cohort-wide access) for 6 months.
- Promotional credits: 250k free-generation tokens per startup, escrowed and released in tranches tied to cohort milestones.
- Pricing: request a 30% discount on list for any paid overages during the cohort, with a single invoice to Soar and Redwood to bill/seat allocation.

Attached is a short SOW and a draft list of eligible use cases. We can share the cohort roster once terms are agreed. Questions: can Redwood support escrowed credits with milestone release (we need an audit trail), and is there flexibility on seat-based flat fees vs per-token billing?

If helpful, I can loop legal; they prefer a short addendum and a payment/escrow schedule.

Best,
Marta Silva
Head of Partnerships — Soar Accelerator
Attachments: Soar_Cohort_SOW.pdf

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Marta Silva <marta@soaraccelerator.org>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot cohort: proposal for bulk seats + escrowed credits

Hi Marta — great to hear and thanks for the SOW. Looping Ben (sales lead) and Lauren (finance) to scope the commercial model. A couple quick answers and a few follow-ups: 

1) Escrowed credits: we can support milestone-triggered credit releases; we typically implement this as an escrowed balance on the account with programmatic release hooks (we'll provide release logs for audit). Want to confirm if Soar wants Redwood to hold the funds/credits or if you'd prefer a third-party escrow (we've done both).

2) Seat-based vs per-token: seat-based flat fees simplify invoicing but can badly under/over-index depending on usage variance across startups. We can offer a hybrid: a per-seat access fee + shared promo-credit pool. For this cohort size, we can model a blended effective per-token rate and set an overage cap.

3) Legal/process: happy to review your addendum. Ben — can you draft two options (A: Redwood-hold-escrow; B: third-party escrow + audit feed)? Lauren — can you confirm invoicing cadence and whether Soar's single invoice requires us to issue sub-ledger reporting per startup?

Marta — can you share a target invoice cadence (monthly/quarterly) and any tax/PO constraints?

Short next step: Ben and I can send a pricing matrix and a proposed milestone/release schedule by Friday.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marta Silva <marta@soaraccelerator.org>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot cohort: proposal for bulk seats + escrowed credits

Hi Marta — looping in a concrete proposal so we can get legal prep started. Attached is a pricing matrix (redwood_pricing_matrix_may2026.xlsx) and a suggested release schedule. Summary: 

Option 1 — Redwood escrow (preferred):
- One upfront payment from Soar to Redwood, Redwood places bulk credits on a program account.
- Release schedule: 25% at cohort kickoff, 50% released in monthly tranches across months 2–4, final 25% on demo day with usage verification.
- Seat fees: $2,000/seat/month (discounted from $2,750), with a 30% discount on list for any overages charged to the program account.

Option 2 — Third-party escrow:
- Soar deposits to escrow agent; agent releases to Redwood on signed release notices. Redwood provides release logs and consumption reports. Seat fees the same; invoicing split monthly.

Notes/asks:
- We need a clear definition of "eligible usage" to avoid credits being applied to non-cohort projects — propose a short playbook clause that credits apply to apps listed in the cohort roster and to projects with tags in metadata.
- Finance asks that Soar provide PO or billing entity name for monthly invoicing if they pick Option 2.
- If Soar prefers a seat lump-sum vs monthly seat fees, we can convert the seat fee into a pre-paid pool with a reconciliation at cohort end.

I've included a HubSpot link to the draft term sheet and a DocuSign template for the escrow addendum. If this looks good, I'll send a redline-friendly PDF to your legal contact.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_pricing_matrix_may2026.xlsx
Related: https://hubspot.example/deals/DEAL-2026-0421-SOAR

From: Marta Silva <marta@soaraccelerator.org>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@soaraccelerator.org
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot cohort: proposal for bulk seats + escrowed credits

Hi Ben / Vanessa — thanks for the clear options and the matrix. We reviewed both and prefer Option 1 (Redwood-hold escrow) for speed — Soar wants Redwood to manage credit release (we will provide milestone attestations). A few clarifying points from legal/finance: 

- Attestation workflow: we'll supply milestone attestations via a signed doc; can Redwood accept an automated webhook + signed PDF as evidence?
- Audit trail: legal wants monthly release logs (date, amount, consuming startup identifier, and consumption report).
- PO / invoicing: we will issue a master PO to Redwood for the upfront commitment; Xero integration preferred but monthly PDF invoices are fine.
- Eligible usage: confirm the playbook clause — we agree to tag cohort projects; Redwood to provide reconciliation and final true-up within 30 days after cohort end.

Next steps: please send the addendum and the DocuSign package and we'll loop legal. Can we also get a one-page summary for our ops team that explains the reconciliation flow and the webhook format?

Appreciate the responsiveness — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marta Silva
Head of Partnerships — Soar Accelerator
Attachments: none
